reviews.text: Thanks Sara. 🙏🏻🐾 …

5 star review for a 5 star service. Our 1:1 sessions with Ali from Homeward Hounds really helped. Our rescue dog had settled in well at home but could be nervous & a bit reactive meeting other dogs. Ali helped us with ways to anticipate, redirect and give her the confidence to engage. We also learned some fun tips that made training fun and engaging.
Thanks to Ali,  she done such a great job with Rosco.  We would definitely recommend her for training your dogs 🐕🐩.

We found Ali fantastic with Millie who is a pup.. she gave us great tools to help train her and are 5 year old Roxy is reactive but the change in 3 lessons is great. The excitement when they saw Ali arrive, they loved her as we did as the reactive dog is definitely calming down and without Ali’s work we would be still at square one with Roxy.. I would highly recommend her 😊
Ali was wonderful from start to finish. Full of useful practical advice to suit our family and help us with our new puppy

Ali is very professional and non judgemental. Knowledgeable with an easy manner.  Generally very helpful and can do. We found the training sessions with our cocker spaniel pup to be very helpful and informative and definitely worthwhile. We would highly recommend her classes.
Ali was great with my two Border Terrier pups. They are both much easier to deal with now with the superb training

Excellent professional service. Alison is very knowledgeable, has a lovely manner with both the dog and their family. She gives lots of advice and follows up with training emails. Would highly recommend her 🐾🐾 …

Our dog had a lovely training experience with Ali. From the moment Ali first came into the house she had a very calming effect on Lexi. We did three 1 hour sessions and covered  using the crate as a safe space, waiting at the door before a walk and recall. Lexi has responded really well to the training so we are delighted. Alison’s techniques are simple to follow and very effective.  Her follow up notes are also very helpful. I would highly recommend Alison if you’re looking for a dog trainer.

We did 3 sessions with Ali to train our Golden Doodle Fred. Ali was incredibly patient, thorough and every tip she gave us was incredibly practical to implement. We saw a huge difference in Fred from the first session, and we feel equipped with the tools needed to continue the training at home. Highly recommend Homeward Hounds!

Very happy with the service. Had a troublesome 8 month old dog. After a few sessions saw a big difference in his behavour. He needs more training but help from homeward hounds has made him a better dog. Highly recommend Homeward hounds. 5 Stars

Ali was brilliant with us and with Luna! She really listened to what our issues were and worked really well with us and Luna! Her insight and knowledge was incredible and so helpful to us! Highly recommend

When we adopted Ted from ‘Molly moos westie rescue’ just before Xmas ‘25, we knew we needed some help getting him settled in. Ali from homeward hounds was fantastic, and fitted us in at short notice. Ted loved his sessions with Ali who was calm, authoritative, and informative. 3 months on he’s well and truly settled and we are much more confident with him. Practicing the tips and tricks Ali gave us is an ongoing mission. Thanks Ali!
Ali's support was instrumental in training our dog. She is such a professional.
Thanks Karina for the 5* much appreciated. 🙏🏻🐾 …

We were trilled with our puppy training. The fountain of knowledge, tips and expert advice was invaluable. We trained two puppies together and will be forever grateful for making it a smooth and fun process for our family and puppies.
I had never owned a dog before but thankfully Ali gave us loads of helpful advice and tips

Ali was a great help with managing our moody teenage cockapoo Milo. We learnt how to preempt and manage situations before they become a problem. Milo is much more content in himself and gets along better with the other dogs in the household
Ali was great and we really enjoyed the training sessions, as did our dog.
Absolutely fantastic Alison is the best so passionate about teaching doge it was just amazing thanks again and Ruby says woof woof

Tilly completed her Teenage Puppy training with Ali and is getting on really well since graduating. Overall her behaviour has calmed hugely in the last month which is great and we have learned how to handle her bursts of energy and demand barking.
There has been hardly any reactivity and the crate downstairs has been a lifesaver for training. Thanks again Ali for all your help! We learned a lot and it has helped our lives so much😄

Ali has been a wonderful help with training our active and lively dog! She has offerred useful, achievable strategies to help manage our dog and has followed up after for any queries we may have. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for help with dog/puppy training

We recently had three sessions with Homeward Hounds and found them to be incredibly helpful. As a wheelchair user, I needed guidance with lead walking to prevent pulling, Alison’s advice in relation to the lead and harness was perfect and her techniques for managing this from my chair were spot on. We also focused on mat training to help my dog stay settled and not jump up at people when they come to the door. Alison was supportive and adapted each exercise to fit our needs perfectly. I’d highly recommend Alison to anyone looking for tailored, practical dog training advice!
Ali is a fabulous trainer - has worked with all 3 of our dogs - with great results. Would highly recommend.

Alison came highly reccomended and was just super with my beautiful Frenchie -  Alafair
She is so good with dogs & puppies and has great patience with them …

We had a fantastic experience with Alison when she trained our golden retriever puppy. Her approach was very friendly, positive and incredibly effective. Alison helped our puppy to build a strong foundation in obedience and basic commands. …

I couldn’t recommend Ali from Homeward Hounds enough. As a first time dog owner (of a wild puppy) We were in desperate need of guidance. We had 3 training sessions, one to one, each session focussing on key areas for puppy training. Ali was …

Before the help of Ali our two miniature schnauzer pups were extremely yappy and difficult to walk, but after Ali’s training our girls have made amazing progress on their leads and are not barking half as much while on walks.  We will be recommending homeward hounds to absolutely everyone!!

Alison came to us highly recommended to train our very lively whippet/collie cross, George! In turn I would like to highly recommend Ali onwards - she did amazing work with George who went from a playful jumper and difficult puppy to walk …
I took dog training lessons from Ali, and they were incredibly practical and clearly laid out. The progressive approach made it easy to understand and apply everything I learned right away. Sarah.
